derivation: from H3808 (לֹא) and H5971 (עַם) with pronominal suffix; not my people;
def: Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea

words.word: upon her that had not obtained mercy

occurrences.text: Then said God, Call his name Lo–ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.

And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
words: upon her that had not obtained mercy
